A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''immigration inspector''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who posed as an inspector for the [[Coruscanti Immigration Service]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. He inspected the passengers of the [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] ''[[Plain Lady]]'' and cross-examined the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] siblings [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]], who at the time were undercover. Detecting no falsehood from the sibling's answers through [[The Force/Legends|The Force]], the Sith inspector allowed them to go their way.

The Sith inspector was prone to extort a ten-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] expediting fee from passengers, which Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] deemed a clever cover to identify enemy agents.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If you haven't been to Coruscant, you go nowhere at UHI.''"<br />"''UHI?''"<br />"''Unlimited Horizons Incorporated. You know&mdash;the UHI that controls most of the pallodenite reserves in the Corporate Sector?''"<br />"''Ah...that UHI. There are so many.|Jysella Horn and the Sith immigration inspector|<ref name="Apocalypse" />}}
The Sith immigration inspector's knowledge of everything outside his Kesh upbringing was minimal. This ignorance, shared by all the other Lost Tribe impostors in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] organizations, was due to their long stay on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] without any contact with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Powers and abilities==
The immigration inspector was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and a member of the Sith Tribe from Kesh. He knew how to detect falsehood using the Force by searching through a person's [[Tutaminis|Force Aura]]. In keeping with his role as an inspector, he was proficient with asking mundane questions to look for any story discrepancies.<ref name="Apocalypse" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Sith immigration inspector first appeared briefly in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2012]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the ninth installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. To date, ''Apocalypse'' is the character's only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].
